<details class="rwv-analysis-details">
<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

This optional verification step is excluded from the default workflow. It uses the same R/community.R functions as 020 to calculate community results independently from the 012 TSEs and compares them by key with archived source-project results in legacy-comparison.tsv. Archived results are comparison inputs, not targets used by the rebuilt calculations. Run with Rscript scripts/render.R --with-checks, Rscript scripts/render-step.R 014-legacy-comparison, or the RStudio Render button. Comparison rules:

- Members, counts, identifiers, taxonomy labels, statuses and permutation p values must be identical.
- Deterministic floating-point values are checked for identity first; otherwise the tolerance is |difference| <= 1e-12 * max(1, |archived value|), accounting for 15 significant digits in TSV files and machine-precision summation differences. Larger differences are labelled different and require review.
- PCoA comparisons first check distance matrices, then coordinates. A whole-axis sign reversal with identical absolute values is labelled sign_equivalent.

Neither archived nor rebuilt results are assumed correct merely because of their age. Differences are documented; the accepted baseline is not replaced automatically.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
raw_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "raw-input-manifest.tsv"))
tse_path <- function(f) rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "012-tse-construction", f)
leg_path <- function(f) rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, paste0("legacy_", f), raw_manifest)
rd_tsv <- function(p) utils::read.delim(p, check.names = FALSE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0))
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
# Independent recomputation with the shared functions of 020 (R/community.R);
# the archived host evidence enters only as the unchanged prediction records.
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(rwv_project_input(step, "config/community.yml", manifest))
cfg_problems <- rwv_community_config_check(cfg)
if (length(cfg_problems)) rwv_fail("config/community.yml selects values that are not implemented: ", paste(cfg_problems, collapse = "; "))
tse_new <- list(virome = readRDS(tse_path("tse_virome.rds")), bact_16s = readRDS(tse_path("tse_16s.rds")),
                euk_18s_all = readRDS(tse_path("tse_18s_all.rds")), euk_18s_microeuk = readRDS(tse_path("tse_18s_microeuk.rds")))
recomputed <- rwv_comm_compute(tse_new, readRDS(tse_path("tse_16s_filtered.rds")), rd_tsv(leg_path("corrected_host_members.tsv")),
                               rd_tsv(leg_path("crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")), cfg, checks)
new_path <- function(f) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
  rwv_write_tsv(recomputed$tables[[sub("\\.tsv$", "", f)]], tmp)
  tmp
}
rows <- list()
tol_rel <- 1e-12
cmp_value <- function(old, new, exact) {
  if (identical(old, new)) return(c("identical", "0"))
  on <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(old)); nn <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(new))
  if (exact || is.na(on) || is.na(nn)) {
    if (!is.na(on) && !is.na(nn) && on == nn) return(c("identical", "0"))
    return(c("different", if (!is.na(on) && !is.na(nn)) format(nn - on, digits = 6) else "non-numeric"))
  }
  d <- nn - on
  if (d == 0) return(c("identical", "0"))
  if (abs(d) <= tol_rel * max(1, abs(on))) return(c("within_tolerance", format(d, digits = 6)))
  c("different", format(d, digits = 6))
}
add_rows <- function(metric, key, old, new, criterion, exact, figures) {
  res <- t(mapply(cmp_value, old, new, MoreArgs = list(exact = exact)))
  rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(metric = metric, key = key, legacy_value = old, new_value = new,
                                           difference = res[, 2], criterion = criterion, status = res[, 1], figures = figures)
}
```

### Task 2: Compare community tables by key

```{r}
#| label: tables
tables <- list(
  list(f = "composition_full.tsv", keys = c("omic", "sample_id", "taxon"), num = c("abundance_sum", "relative_abundance"), exact = character(0), fig = "F1B-D, Data 1 S02"),
  list(f = "feature_taxonomy.tsv", keys = c("omic", "feature_id"), num = character(0), exact = c("raw_label", "display_taxon"), fig = "F1B-D, Data 1 S04"),
  list(f = "alpha_summary.tsv", keys = c("experiment", "sample_id"), num = c("shannon", "pielou", "faith"), exact = c("observed"), fig = "F2A, S1"),
  list(f = "virome_alpha.tsv", keys = c("sample_id"), num = c("shannon", "pielou", "shannon_sd", "shannon_unrarefied", "pielou_unrarefied"),
       exact = c("masked_reads", "rarefy_depth", "observed", "observed_sd", "observed_unrarefied"), fig = "F2A, S1B"),
  list(f = "viral_load_per_sample.tsv", keys = c("sample_id"), num = c("viral_fraction"), exact = c("mapped_viral_reads", "clean_reads"), fig = "S1B"),
  list(f = "virome_depth_check.tsv", keys = c("metric"), num = c("spearman_rho"), exact = character(0), fig = "S1B"),
  list(f = "label_pairs.tsv", keys = c("experiment", "pair"), num = c("shannon_clean", "shannon_dirty", "shannon_diff_dirty_minus_clean"),
       exact = c("observed_clean", "observed_dirty"), fig = "F2A"),
  list(f = "pcoa_aitchison.tsv", keys = c("omic", "sample_id"), num = c("axis1_percent", "axis2_percent"), exact = character(0), fig = "F2B"),
  list(f = "permanova_marginal.tsv", keys = c("experiment", "dissimilarity", "term"), num = c("R2", "F_stat"), exact = c("df", "p"), fig = "Data 1 S10"),
  list(f = "betadisper_summary.tsv", keys = c("experiment", "diss_x_group"), num = c("p_betadisper", "p_betadisper_parametric", "p_betadisper_parametric_bias_adjusted"),
       exact = c("p_betadisper_permutation", "p_betadisper_permutation_bias_adjusted", "dispersion_status"), fig = "Data 1 S11"),
  list(f = "crossomics_pairwise.tsv", keys = c("pair"), num = c("proc_m2", "proc_corr", "mantel_r", "rv_coef"), exact = c("proc_p", "mantel_p"), fig = "F2C, Data 1 S09"),
  list(f = "corrected_host_members.tsv", keys = c("vOTU_id"), num = character(0),
       exact = c("host_in_16s_clean", "visibility_status", "in_127_named_visible_set", "host_prevalence_saved", "n_codetected_saved"), fig = "F2D, S2A, Data 1 S12"),
  list(f = "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv", keys = c("vOTU_id", "host_genus"), num = character(0),
       exact = c("host_visible_in_16s", "n_codetected_masked", "n_codetected_raw", "votu_prevalence"), fig = "F2D, Data 1 S13"))
key_report <- list()
for (tb in tables) {
  old <- rd_tsv(leg_path(tb$f)); new <- rd_tsv(new_path(tb$f))
  ko <- do.call(paste, c(old[tb$keys], sep = " | ")); kn <- do.call(paste, c(new[tb$keys], sep = " | "))
  key_report[[tb$f]] <- data.frame(table = tb$f, legacy_keys = length(ko), new_keys = length(kn),
                                   only_legacy = length(setdiff(ko, kn)), only_new = length(setdiff(kn, ko)), duplicated = anyDuplicated(ko) + anyDuplicated(kn))
  common <- intersect(ko, kn)
  io <- match(common, ko); inn <- match(common, kn)
  # Every legacy column must exist in the rebuilt table; added columns are listed.
  miss_cols <- setdiff(colnames(old), colnames(new)); add_cols <- setdiff(colnames(new), colnames(old))
  key_report[[tb$f]]$missing_columns <- paste(miss_cols, collapse = ", ")
  key_report[[tb$f]]$added_columns <- paste(add_cols, collapse = ", ")
  key_report[[tb$f]]$common_keys <- length(common)
  for (col in tb$num) add_rows(paste(tb$f, col, sep = ":"), common, old[[col]][io], new[[col]][inn], "numeric, rel. tolerance 1e-12", FALSE, tb$fig)
  for (col in tb$exact) add_rows(paste(tb$f, col, sep = ":"), common, old[[col]][io], new[[col]][inn], "exact", TRUE, tb$fig)
}
key_report <- do.call(rbind, key_report)
rwv_check(checks, "every table has the same keys in legacy and rebuilt versions (no key lost or added)", 0L,
          sum(key_report$only_legacy + key_report$only_new + key_report$duplicated))
rwv_check(checks, "no legacy column is missing from a rebuilt table", "", paste(key_report$missing_columns, collapse = ""))
rwv_check(checks, "every table has keys in common (an empty comparison is not a pass)", TRUE, all(key_report$common_keys > 0))
# PCoA coordinates: compared after allowing a whole-axis sign flip.
old <- rd_tsv(leg_path("pcoa_aitchison.tsv")); new <- rd_tsv(new_path("pcoa_aitchison.tsv"))
for (o in unique(old$omic)) for (ax in c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")) {
  a <- as.numeric(old[[ax]][old$omic == o]); b <- as.numeric(new[[ax]][new$omic == o][match(old$sample_id[old$omic == o], new$sample_id[new$omic == o])])
  same <- max(abs(a - b)) <= tol_rel * max(1, abs(a)); flip <- max(abs(a + b)) <= tol_rel * max(1, abs(a))
  rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(metric = paste0("pcoa_aitchison.tsv:", ax), key = paste(o, "all samples"),
    legacy_value = paste(signif(a, 8), collapse = "; "), new_value = paste(signif(b, 8), collapse = "; "),
    difference = format(max(abs(a - b)), digits = 6), criterion = "coordinates up to a whole-axis sign flip",
    status = if (identical(a, b)) "identical" else if (same) "within_tolerance" else if (flip) "sign_equivalent" else "different", figures = "F2B")
}
```

### Task 3: Compare TSE assays, taxonomy and distance objects

```{r}
#| label: objects
objs <- c(tse_virome = "tse_virome.rds", tse_16s = "tse_16s.rds", tse_18s_all = "tse_18s_all.rds", tse_18s_microeuk = "tse_18s_microeuk.rds")
exact_assays <- c("count", "count_masked", "covered_fraction", "counts", "rarefied")
obj_rows <- list()
orow <- function(object, item, legacy = "", new = "", d = NA_real_, status) {
  obj_rows[[length(obj_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(object = object, item = item, legacy = legacy, new = new, max_abs_difference = d, status = status)
}
# Name sets first: a legacy name missing from the rebuilt object is a
# difference; a rebuilt name without a legacy counterpart is listed as an
# addition. An empty common set never counts as "no difference".
name_sets <- function(object, what, old_names, new_names) {
  ns <- rwv_name_sets(old_names, new_names)
  orow(object, paste(what, "set: legacy names present in the rebuilt object"),
       legacy = paste(old_names, collapse = ", "), new = paste(new_names, collapse = ", "), status = ns$status)
  if (length(ns$missing)) orow(object, paste(what, "missing in the rebuilt object"), legacy = paste(ns$missing, collapse = ", "), status = "different")
  if (length(ns$added)) orow(object, paste(what, "added in the rebuilt object (allowed)"), new = paste(ns$added, collapse = ", "), status = "added")
  ns$common
}
for (nm in names(objs)) {
  o <- readRDS(leg_path(objs[[nm]])); n <- readRDS(tse_path(objs[[nm]]))
  # Sample labels and the key sample metadata.
  samples_ok <- setequal(colnames(o), colnames(n)) && length(colnames(n)) == 7L
  orow(nm, "sample labels (colnames)", paste(colnames(o), collapse = ", "), paste(colnames(n), collapse = ", "),
       status = if (samples_ok) "identical" else "different")
  if (!samples_ok) next
  o <- o[, colnames(n)]
  co <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(o), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cn <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(n), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (col in c("sample_id", "location", "water_condition", "desc")) {
    orow(nm, paste("colData", col),
         status = if (col %in% colnames(co) && col %in% colnames(cn) && identical(as.character(co[[col]]), as.character(cn[[col]]))) "identical" else "different")
  }
  same_ids <- identical(rownames(o), rownames(n))
  orow(nm, "dimensions and row/column IDs (same order)", paste(dim(o), collapse = " x "), paste(dim(n), collapse = " x "),
       status = if (identical(dim(o), dim(n)) && same_ids) "identical" else "different")
  for (a in name_sets(nm, "assay", SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(o), SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(n))) {
    x <- as.matrix(SummarizedExperiment::assay(o, a))[rownames(n), , drop = FALSE]; y <- as.matrix(SummarizedExperiment::assay(n, a))
    # Values are compared, not storage attributes (integer vs double, dimnames).
    d <- max(abs(x - y))
    st <- if (identical(dim(x), dim(y)) && identical(is.na(x), is.na(y)) && isTRUE(d == 0)) "identical" else
      if (!(a %in% exact_assays) && d <= tol_rel * max(1, max(abs(x)))) "within_tolerance" else "different"
    orow(nm, paste("assay", a), d = d, status = st)
  }
  ro <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(o), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[rownames(n), , drop = FALSE]
  rn <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(n), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (col in name_sets(nm, "rowData field", colnames(ro), colnames(rn))) {
    if (!identical(as.character(ro[[col]]), as.character(rn[[col]]))) orow(nm, paste("rowData", col), status = "different")
  }
}
orow("tse_16s_filtered", "not compared: an intermediate object of the rebuild (filtered 16S before rarefaction) without a legacy counterpart",
     status = "not_compared")
obj <- do.call(rbind, obj_rows)
leg_div <- readRDS(leg_path("mae_diversity.rds"))
new_dist <- recomputed$distances
dist_rows <- list()
drow <- function(object, item, d = NA_real_, status, legacy = "", new = "") {
  dist_rows[[length(dist_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(object = object, item = item, legacy = legacy, new = new, max_abs_difference = d, status = status)
}
exps <- intersect(names(leg_div), names(new_dist))
drow("distances", "assay set with distances: legacy assays present in the rebuilt result",
     legacy = paste(names(leg_div), collapse = ", "), new = paste(names(new_dist), collapse = ", "),
     status = rwv_name_sets(names(leg_div), names(new_dist))$status)
for (e in exps) {
  old_d <- names(S4Vectors::metadata(leg_div[[e]])$diss); new_d <- names(new_dist[[e]])
  ns <- rwv_name_sets(old_d, new_d)
  drow(paste(e, "distance"), "distance set: legacy distances present in the rebuilt result", legacy = paste(old_d, collapse = ", "),
       new = paste(new_d, collapse = ", "), status = ns$status)
  for (d in ns$common) {
    x <- S4Vectors::metadata(leg_div[[e]])$diss[[d]]; y <- new_dist[[e]][[d]]
    x <- x[rownames(y), colnames(y)]
    md <- max(abs(x - y))
    drow(paste(e, "distance"), d, d = md,
         status = if (isTRUE(md == 0)) "identical" else if (md <= tol_rel * max(1, max(abs(x)))) "within_tolerance" else "different")
  }
}
obj <- rbind(obj, do.call(rbind, dist_rows))
rwv_check(checks, "no legacy assay, rowData field, sample label or distance is missing from the rebuilt objects", 0L,
          sum(obj$status == "different" & grepl("set:|missing|sample labels|colData", obj$item)))
tax_na <- c("vOTU1454", "vOTU1643", "vOTU2101", "vOTU2461", "vOTU2535", "vOTU2648", "vOTU2816", "vOTU2852", "vOTU3035", "vOTU3237", "vOTU3385", "vOTU3435", "vOTU3453", "vOTU3572")
lv <- readRDS(leg_path("tse_virome.rds"))
rwv_check(checks, "the 14 vOTUs without a formatted-taxonomy row also had empty taxonomy in the legacy object", TRUE,
          all(is.na(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(lv)[tax_na, "tax_class"])))
knitr::kable(obj, digits = 20)
```

### Task 4: Summarize differences and review decisions

```{r}
#| label: verdict
cmpt <- do.call(rbind, rows)
cmpt$cause <- ifelse(cmpt$status == "identical", "same inputs, same algorithm, same random draw",
               ifelse(cmpt$status == "within_tolerance", "floating-point summation order / 15-digit TSV serialisation",
               ifelse(cmpt$status == "sign_equivalent", "arbitrary PCoA axis sign", "unexplained: needs review")))
cmpt$verdict <- ifelse(cmpt$status == "different", "hold for Codex; the formal baseline is not replaced", "promotable")
obj$cause <- ifelse(obj$status %in% c("identical", "added", "not_compared"), "",
              ifelse(obj$status == "within_tolerance", "floating-point summation order", "unexplained: needs review"))
summary_tab <- stats::aggregate(list(rows = rep(1L, nrow(cmpt))), by = list(metric = sub(":.*", "", cmpt$metric), status = cmpt$status), FUN = sum)
summary_tab <- summary_tab[order(summary_tab$metric, summary_tab$status, method = "radix"), ]
rwv_write_tsv(cmpt, path_target("legacy-comparison.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(obj, path_target("object-comparison.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(key_report, path_target("key-report.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(summary_tab, path_target("comparison-summary.tsv"))
rwv_check(checks, "comparison rows written for every compared value", TRUE, nrow(cmpt) > 0)
knitr::kable(summary_tab, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Different (needs review):", sum(cmpt$status == "different"), "of", nrow(cmpt), "values;",
    sum(obj$status == "different"), "object items differ;", sum(obj$status == "added"), "additions listed.\n")
check_table <- rwv_checks_finish(checks, path_target("comparison-checks.tsv"))
rwv_write_session_info(path_target("session-info.txt"),
                       c(step = params$name, run_id = step$run_id, mode = step$mode, quarto = rwv_quarto_version()))
```
